guide_solution: (a) Countries of the world rely heavily on petroleum, coal and natural gas for their energy sources. (b) Most renewable energy comes either directly or indirectly from the sun. (c) The sun's heat drives the wind and this wind energy can be captured with wind turbines to produce electricity. (d) Then the wind and the sun's heat cause water to evaporate. (e) When this water vapour turns into rain or snow and flows downhill into rivers or streams, its energy can be captured as hydroelectric energy. → → → → → → →
